why: The Molecule Combination panel renders the composite with NGL instead of plotly. Plotly's only advantage in that panel was clicking a bead to choose a linkage endpoint, and the head and tail endpoint comboboxes now cover that, so the picker and the plotly scenes both go.
path_choice: Vendored rather than served from a python package. Plotly can be served out of its installed package -- routes/catalog.py reads plotly/package_data/plotly.min.js -- but NGL has no browser package (nglview's javascript is a Jupyter widget bundle) and py3Dmol 2.5.5 ships no javascript at all, fetching 3Dmol from a CDN at runtime. So neither viewer can follow the plotly pattern.
note: Tracked on purpose so a fresh clone stays offline. This is a UMD bundle: a plain script tag loads it, there is no build step, and the file is already minified -- jsdelivr's ngl.min.js only adds a notice saying so.
